{"search_note":"Gap note:
- I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence on **sanctions management** because Vietnam was not a central sanctions case that year.
- I also did not find a clean Trọng-specific source on **unemployment policy response**; the evidence base is mostly macro-financial, debt, inflation, export, and investment stability.
- After **July 18, 2024**, direct attribution to Trọng weakens materially because the Politburo transferred his duties to Tô Lâm.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Staff Completes 2024 Article IV Mission to Vietnam","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-06-26","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/26/pr24239-vietnam-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission","summary":"The IMF credited government actions for recovery from 2023 real-estate and export shocks, projected close to 6% growth in 2024, and said inflation was expected to stay around the State Bank target. This supports a competence reading on shocks, inflation, and debt management.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7","5B.1"]},{"title":"Vietnam: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director for Vietnam","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/09/27/vietnam-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-the-555679","summary":"The IMF said domestic demand was still subdued as firms navigated high debt, the real-estate sector would recover only gradually, and banking vulnerabilities persisted. That is evidence of both problem recognition and unresolved weakness.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board Concludes 2024 Article IV Consultation with Vietnam","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/09/27/pr24347-vietnam-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-article-iv-consult","summary":"The IMF commended swift actions to maintain macro-financial stability, welcomed steps to strengthen the financial system, and noted authorities had contained risks from the SCB failure and real-estate/corporate-bond stress.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Viet Nam’s Economy Poised for Gradual Recovery, World Bank Report Finds","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-04-23","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/04/23/viet-nam-s-economy-poised-for-gradual-recovery-world-bank-report-finds","summary":"The World Bank said the economy was recovering but still mixed, with exports improving and private investment only gradually recovering. This supports a reading of cautious, evidence-based macro management.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Macro Poverty Outlook for Viet Nam: October 2024","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-10-01","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099909510142420086","summary":"The Bank projected 6.1% growth in 2024 and a continued poverty decline, but still emphasized that domestic demand was only gradually recovering. That supports measured management, not miracle claims.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.8","5B.6"]},{"title":"State Bank of Vietnam Flexibly Manages and Promotes Credit Growth Associated with Macroeconomic Stabilization","publisher":"State Bank of Vietnam / DIV mirror","date":"2024-08-20","url":"https://www.div.gov.vn/state-bank-of-vietnam-flexibly-manages-and-promotes-credit-growth-associated-with-macroeconomic-stabilization1","summary":"The SBV reported stable first-half inflation, managed credit growth, and maintained banking-system safety. This is one of the clearest competence signals in the record.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Foreigners sell Vietnam securities amid political turbulence, data show","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-05-17","url":"https://theprint.in/world/foreigners-sell-vietnam-securities-amid-political-turbulence-data-show/2089403/","summary":"Reuters said political upheaval and anti-graft prosecutions slowed the administration, delayed approvals, and worried investors about power supply and capital access. This is strong negative evidence on competence.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.4","5B.6","5B.7"]},{"title":"Vietnam removes third top leader in two months, reshuffles cadres","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-05-20","url":"https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/","summary":"This supports the negative side of the lens: even if anti-corruption was real, the process was politically destabilizing and impaired state capacity.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.5","5B.6","5B.7"]},{"title":"Vietnam misses out on Intel, LG Chem investments due to lack of incentives, ministry document shows","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-07-05","url":"https://theprint.in/tech/vietnam-misses-out-on-intel-lg-chem-investments-due-to-lack-of-incentives-ministry-document-shows/2162549/","summary":"Reuters reported that major investments were lost because policy frameworks were not workable enough, which is negative evidence for competent economic crisis handling.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.4","5B.6","5B.7"]},{"title":"Viet Nam | Data","publisher":"World Bank","date":"current data page, accessed recently","url":"https://data.worldbank.org/country/viet-nam","summary":"The data page shows low unemployment in the period, but it is not a Trọng-specific 2024 policy record and is too indirect to carry much weight for this lens.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6"]}]}
